company.name: Clicksco
company.shortDescription: Clicksco is a digital performance-focused agency that provides marketing and customer acquisition services.
company.description: Clicksco is a digital agency operating in the performance marketing sector. The company provides services related to digital advertising, customer acquisition, and campaign delivery across online channels. Clicksco became part of the All Response Media group and the Havas Group in 2019, supporting the group’s digital marketing activities. The company works within the group structure to contribute to digital campaign planning, execution, and performance measurement for clients.
